Adventure Quiz - Capcom World + Hatena n.name: Adventure Quiz: Capcom World - Hatena no Daibouken
Adventure Quiz - Capcom World + Hatena n.summary: A PC Engine CD-ROM compilation of the first two Arcade games in the Adventure Quiz/Capcom World series. The player answers questions about Capcom games to further a story.

Quiz Avenue III.name: Quiz Avenue III
Quiz Avenue III.summary: A trivia and role-playing hybrid game released for the PC Engine Super CD-ROM² released in 1994. Different to its predecessors, it wraps quiz game mechanics inside an RPG framework complete with a story quest and battle mode.
